replies.text:
Check of commonly-missed items:

- Automated abuse of a reachable endpoint: design has "it writes memories automatically" driven by user chat; covered by listed threat 3 (unbounded automatic memory writing / cost).
- Staff/admin/moderator screens showing user-supplied content: design only says memories are "used in later answers" — no privileged screen stated. Not applicable.
- Delete / moderate / refund / role-change without a record: no such action in the design. Not applicable, except that memory creation itself has no record (see below).
- Personal pages/documents cacheable by browsers, proxies or CDNs: nothing in the design about pages, downloads or responses being cached. Not applicable.
- Attacker-controlled text reaching logs, CSV exports, emails, headers or another interpreting system: design only states memories are fed back into answers; that path is covered by listed threat 4. No export/log/email sink stated. Not applicable.
- Unconfirmed reviewer threats: client-supplied identity (their #1, #5) overlaps listed threat 2, which already names "an attacker supplies another user's id/email"; false-fact poisoning (their #3, #6) overlaps listed threats 4 and 5. Their #2/#4 — no provenance on automatically written memories — is real here and not covered: the design says memories are written automatically and reused, and no listed threat addresses traceability of which memory drove an answer.

{
  "schema": "threatline.threatmodel.v1",
  "issueKey": "EVAL-07",
  "sketch": {
    "components": ["customer chatbot", "memory writer", "memory retrieval", "LLM prompt"],
    "dataStores": ["memory store"],
    "externalServices": ["LLM provider"],
    "trustBoundaries": ["user chat input -> memory store", "memory store -> model prompt"],
    "dataClasses": ["pii"],
    "exposure": "internal",
    "llmFeatures": true
  },
  "threats": [
    {
      "stride": "Repudiation",
      "title": "Memories written silently with no source or timestamp, so bad answers cannot be traced or corrected",
      "scenario": "A memory is written automatically from a conversation and later drives a wrong, poisoned or stale answer to a customer. Because the design records no source, time or conversation reference for each memory, operators cannot tell which memory produced the answer, when it was written or from which conversation it came. A user can also deny ever saying the remembered fact. Poisoning and disclosure incidents cannot be investigated, and a correction or deletion request cannot be honoured precisely.",
      "component": "memory store / automatic memory writer",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 2,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "minor" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Users can tell it anything; it writes memories automatically and uses them in later answers." }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V7.1.3"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-778"],
      "plainLanguage": "The bot saves facts about people without noting where each fact came from, so when it answers wrongly nobody can find or fix the memory that caused it.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Record provenance for every automatically written memory",
        "given": "the chatbot writes a memory automatically from a conversation",
        "when": "the memory is stored and later retrieved into an answer",
        "then": "the record carries the authenticated subject, write timestamp and source conversation/message reference, and the memories used in an answer are logged so a specific memory can be traced, corrected or deleted"
      }
    }
  ]
}
